cards.title: git log
cards.body: `git log` lists commits, newest first. `git log --oneline` shows one short line per commit.
cards.code:
git init
touch a.txt
git add .
git commit -m "First"
touch b.txt
git add .
git commit -m "Second"
git log --oneline

hi.title: git log
hi.body: `git log` commits ki list dikhata hai, sabse naya pehle. `git log --oneline` har commit ki ek chhoti line dikhata hai.

cards.title: The edit, add, commit loop
cards.body: Working with Git is a loop: change files, `git add` them, `git commit`. Each round adds a snapshot you can come back to.

hi.title: Edit, add, commit ka loop
hi.body: Git ke saath kaam ek loop hai: files badlo, unhe `git add` karo, `git commit` karo. Har round ek snapshot jodta hai jis par aap wapas aa sakte ho.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: The last command fails. Tap it.
cards.code:
git add .
git commit -m "Add todo list"
git logs

bug.fix: The history command is `git log`, with no s.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Aakhri command fail hoti hai. Us par tap karo.
hi.fix: History wali command `git log` hai, bina s ke.

check.question: Which command shows one short line per commit?
check.explanation: `git log --oneline` prints each commit as a short id and its message.

hi.question: Kaunsi command har commit ki ek chhoti line dikhati hai?
hi.explanation: `git log --oneline` har commit ko ek chhoti id aur uske message ke saath print karta hai.

exercise.prompt: This repo already has one commit. Create `about.html` with `touch about.html`, then stage it and commit it with the message `Add about page`.
exercise.promptHi: Is repo mein pehle se ek commit hai. `touch about.html` se `about.html` banao, phir use stage karo aur message `Add about page` ke saath commit karo.
